chunks: For those who do good there is goodness and more, and no blot or disgrace will cover their faces. They are people of Paradise, where they will abide for ever.
ai.seo_question: What is the ultimate reward for those who do good according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Husna' is often interpreted not merely as Paradise but as the ultimate vision of God (Ru'yat Allah), with 'Ziyadah' referring to the additional reward of proximity to the Prophet and Ahl al-Bayt. The phrase 'la yarqahu wujuhahum qatar' signifies that their faces will not be darkened by the dust of death or the humiliation of the Day of Judgment, reflecting the spiritual purity attained through following the Imams. This verse thus encapsulates the dual reward of eternal bliss and enduring dignity for those who embody true righteousness.
